name: Apple Summary Slides
summary: Unofficial collection of Apple's bento-style summary slides from events and keynotes.
description: An unofficial gallery of the bento-grid summary slides Apple uses to recap products at its events and WWDC keynotes. Slides are grouped by event (September events and WWDC, 2020-2026) and by product line (iPhone, Mac, AirPods, Vision, Apple Intelligence).
contains: 34 gallery entries in the catalog index
grouped by event (WWDC, September events) and product (iPhone, Mac, AirPods, AI)
